It is mandatory to register on Techfest Website . further details will be updated on the Website only .


About

The Algo Trading Innovation Challenge is a national fintech competition by Delta Exchange and Techfest, IIT Bombay, built around a stark fact: SEBI found that 87.7% of individual equity-derivatives traders made net losses in FY26. Teams study Delta Exchange's AlgoHub, its ecosystem of six algorithmic trading features, identify a significant gap that Futures and Options traders face, and design an original, AI-assisted capability that goes beyond what the platform offers today. The top 50 teams turn their ideas into working prototypes at an on-campus hackathon at Techfest, IIT Bombay, Asia's largest science and technology festival.

Structure

The competition runs in two rounds, with Round 2 as an on-campus hackathon at Techfest, IIT Bombay.

  • Eligibility: Open to all students with a valid ID from their educational institution. Cross-institutional teams are encouraged.
  • Team size: Maximum 4 members per team.
  • The Challenge: Teams select one or two (maximum two) of the six AlgoHub features, Algo Marketplace, Algo Builder, API Copilot, Trading Bot, APIs, or Trade Data, identify a significant product gap or unmet need that F&O traders face within them, and design an innovative, AI-assisted capability that adds meaningful functionality beyond what exists today. Teams may propose an independent innovation per feature or one unified solution covering both. Delta Exchange is already working on natural-language strategy creation, backtesting, and trading intelligence, so teams are encouraged not to build their proposal primarily around those capabilities.

Round 1 - Online Submission (Screening)

A conceptual round; no working prototype is required and teams do not need to deploy live strategies or trade with real capital. Teams submit a presentation of no more than 6 slides (PPT/PPTX or PDF export) covering:

  • Selected Feature(s) & Product Understanding
  • Problem Identification & Product Gap
  • Proposed AI-Assisted Innovation
  • Real-World Trading Use Case
  • Technical Approach & Feasibility
  • Expected Impact & Value

Only the Team Leader may submit. The 50 highest-scoring teams qualify for Round 2; ties at the cutoff are broken by the higher score in Innovation & AI Application, then Problem Identification & Trader Relevance, then Technical Feasibility.

Round 2 - On-Campus Hackathon at IIT Bombay

The top 50 teams develop their proposed innovations into working prototypes and demonstrate them at Techfest, IIT Bombay. Detailed format and judging guidelines will be shared with shortlisted teams.

Timeline

  • Registration closes - 30th November 2026
  • Round 1 submission deadline - 30th November 2026
  • Shortlist announcement - 5th December 2026
  • Finals (on-campus hackathon at IIT Bombay) - 15th-18th December 2026

Rewards and Prizes

  • INR 50,000 for the top 3 winners.
  • Certificates for all participants who qualify for Round 2.
